CheckSelectedDomainStatus.description_en: Queries the status and price of a Buy Now premium domain name. The results are the same as the search results on the domain name trading homepage of mi.aliyun.com
CheckSelectedDomainStatus.description_zh: 查询一口价严选商品状态与价格，结果等同于mi.aliyun.com域名交易首页检索结果

CreateFixedPriceSelectedOrder.description_en: Places an order for a fixed-price premium domain name. If the call is successful, the payment is automatically deducted from your Alibaba Cloud account balance
CreateFixedPriceSelectedOrder.description_zh: 一口价严选域名商品下单接口，调用成功会自动从阿里云账户余额进行扣款

QueryBrokerDemand.description_en: Queries the list of demand details

SelectedDomainList.description_en: Exports the full list of buy-now premium domain names currently on sale for the current day
SelectedDomainList.description_zh: 导出今日全量在售一口价严选域名列表
